freePlan.limits: 500 free macOS M2 build minutes per month, 1 parallel build, community support only

keyLimits.en: 500 macOS M2 build minutes per month, 1 parallel build, 30-day build history, 1 team member.
Usage-based: $0.045/min Linux or Windows, $0.095/min Mac mini M2, $0.114/min Mac mini M4; unlimited team members, 60-day build history, $49/month per extra concurrency.
Billed as $3,990/year (about $332.50/month equivalent), 3 concurrent builds included, 1-year build history.
Starting at $12,000/year, custom configuration, SSO, priority support and dedicated account management.

cautions.en: Mac build minutes are billed at a much higher rate than Linux/Windows ($0.095-0.114/min vs $0.045/min), which matters for iOS-heavy pipelines.
cautions.fr: Les minutes de build Mac coûtent beaucoup plus cher que Linux/Windows (0,095-0,114$/min contre 0,045$/min), ce qui pèse sur les pipelines iOS.

capabilities.en: CI/CD pipelines for Flutter, React Native, native iOS/Android, Ionic, Unity and .NET MAUI.
Automates code signing, building, uploading new app versions and store submissions.
Mobile CodePush-style over-the-air updates billed separately per install or MAU.

limitations.en: Free tier gives only 1 parallel build and 500 minutes/month, too little for an active mobile team.
SSO is Enterprise-only, unavailable even on the Fixed Price tiers.
Mac hardware minutes are priced well above Linux/Windows minutes, so iOS build costs scale fast.
